@@ -0,0 +1,21 @@
+---

+position_column: todo
+position_ordinal: '8880'
+title: 'Inkling 2 prefill: tune the relative attention kernel for long contexts'
+---
+## Why
+Prefill falls from 4725 tok/s at 2k to 3585 at 32k and 2732 at 64k. Only the 8 full-attention visits grow with the context. `inkling2RelativeAttention` uses a query block of 32 (`relativeAttentionQueryBlock`) and 128 threads (`relativeAttentionThreads`), and it may also apply the sliding-window bound inefficiently on full layers.
+
+## What
+- Microbenchmark `inkling2RelativeAttention` at a 2048-query chunk against 8k, 32k and 64k keys.
+- Sweep the query block (32 or 64), the threads, the key tile, and the K/V reuse across the query heads of one KV head.
+- Compare the result to `MLXFast.scaledDotProductAttention` at the same shapes as an upper bound on speed. It has no relative bias, so it is a reference only.
+
+## Acceptance
+- [ ] inklingcheck.sh: CHECK PASS.
+- [ ] inklingbench.sh shows a prefill gain at 32k and 64k beyond the noise.
+- [ ] The relative attention kernel tests pass. #inkling-perf
\ No newline at end of file

forward_patch:
--- original
+++ modified
@@ -1,6 +1,24 @@
 ---
 assignees:
 - claude-code
+comments:
+- actor: claude-code
+  id: 01m84c9j2j7r0n309nr4416yhq
+  text: |-
+    ## Result: no tuning win. The kernel is compute-bound at ~21 TFLOP/s; MLX's SDPA reaches ~74 TFLOP/s
+    Env knobs, prefill tok/s at 8k / 32k / 64k (2k is flat):
+    - BQ (query block; threads = BQ/8 simdgroups): 32 (old) 4593/3580/2734; 64 4621/3589/2722; 128 4462/3463/2621.
+    - BK (key tile): 16 (old) 4585/–/2736; 32 4521/–/2607; 32 with BQ 64 4599/–/2738; 64 with BQ 64 4595/–/2735.
+    - BQ is bit-exact, since each row walks the same tiles; BK is not. Neither gains, so both are reverted.
+
+    Where the long-context time goes:
+    - 64k prefill is 2734 tok/s against 4745 at 2k, about 10 s more for a 64k prompt.
+    - The 8 full-attention visits do ~211 TFLOP of causal QK+PV, so the kernel runs at ~21 TFLOP/s.
+    - The KV cache growth (`KVCacheSimple` concatenates on each chunk) totals only ~34 GB of copies at 64k, ~0.03 s. Not the cause.
+    - `MLXFast.scaledDotProductAttention`, L=2048, bf16, causal: 3.6 ms at S=8k, 11.1 at 32k, **22.3 ms at 64k (~74 TFLOP/s)**. Our kernel is ~78 ms at 64k: 3.5x slower.
+
+    Follow-up card: run the far keys (distance ≥ R=1024, where the relative bias is zero) through SDPA and the near band through our kernel, then merge the two by their log-sum-exp. Estimated +40% prefill at 64k and ~+20% at 32k. The open problem: MLX's SDPA does not return the LSE.
+  timestamp: 2026-11-23T14:17:23.794728+00:00
